skitStage.speaker: Everyone
skitStage.line: Skit plays. Advance when it ends.

skitText.speaker: Cara
skitText.line: Robux is just one kind of bait. Scammers also send texts like this one.

fbiWarning.speaker: Cara
fbiWarning.line: The FBI warned about toll texts like this in 2024, after more than 2,000 complaints were filed in a single month.

topContact.speaker: Anne
topContact.line: Text is now the number one way scammers reach people.

weekly.speaker: Anne
weekly.line: In fact, 61% of American adults get a scam text every week.

losses.speaker: Anne
losses.line: And in 2024, people reported losing $470 million to text scams, more than five times as much as in 2020.

phones.speaker: Jerry
phones.line: What's worse, kids are getting these texts too. Over half of all kids starting middle school already have their own phone,

youngLosses.speaker: Jerry
youngLosses.line: and they're the most likely to lose money. Half the fraud reports from people 19 and under involve a loss, more than any other age.

aiTypos.speaker: Alexis (Kid)
aiTypos.line: And with AI, it's become harder and harder to detect scam texts. Typos and poor grammar are no longer a giveaway!

pawnzyLesson.speaker: Cara
pawnzyLesson.line: That's why we made Pawnzy’s lesson, so kids learn the signs before they ever need Pawnzy to swoop in.

fourPs.speaker: Cara
fourPs.line: It teaches the same four red flags the FTC tells parents to teach: Pretend, Problem, Pressure, Pay.

fades.speaker: Jerry
fades.line: A lesson taught once is forgotten within four weeks. That's why Pawnzy's lesson should be on Duolingo, where kids come back every day.

drawSketch.speaker: Anne
drawSketch.line: We drew Pawnzy ourselves. Every new feeling started as a rough sketch like these.

drawLayers.speaker: Anne
drawLayers.line: Then we drew the final art one layer at a time. This pose alone has thirteen layers.

drawPoses.speaker: Cara
drawPoses.line: Then we drew a new pose for each feeling, so Pawnzy can think, cheer or feel sad as kids answer.

ending.speaker: Everyone
ending.line: Together, let's help educate young people everywhere and protect them from text scams.

play.speaker: Cara
play.line: So, now it's your turn! Grab your phone and see if you can spot scam texts with the help of Pawnzy!
